claims.statement: The live system produces very high recurring volume: about 1.6 billion containers were returned through 62000 points by the end of May 2026.
Retail obligations and required operator agreements create a recurring settlement workflow for covered stores.
Eight authorised operators are listed by the Ministry, creating genuine multi-operator complexity.
Kaucyjni already offers one multi-operator panel, POS/RVM integration, reports and settlement visibility for stores and chains.
Kaucyjni's integrated public plans cost 39.90-79.90 PLN net per store per month, materially below the candidate's proposed price.
Working multi-operator integrations require signed operator agreements, portal access and operator-specific store identifiers; access is possible but relationship-bound.
TOMRA, Kaucja.pl and PolKa provide APIs, session or count data, reporting and settlement tools that can substitute for a neutral reconciliation layer.
High volume and multiple operators imply a large reconciliation surface, but they do not prove that unresolved, recoverable discrepancies are economically material after incumbent controls.
A 20-50-store chain will pay a premium or success fee for independent audit recoveries beyond existing tools.
A read-only file audit is compatible with the founder's capital and part-time constraints, while live integrations and field service are not yet demonstrated to be delegable within the same envelope.

contrary_evidence: A near-exact multi-operator competitor already has POS distribution, operator connections, reporting and settlement modules.
That competitor's public integrated price is below 80 PLN per store per month.
RVM vendors and system operators provide their own data, APIs and reconciliation tooling.
No direct evidence quantifies unresolved recoverable leakage per store or proves that it persists after system maturation.
